fields.instructions: 2026-08-06: the 4 multipliers below drive the "Estimated Annual Value" figure on both the popup handoff and the standalone page (inc/solution-builder.php) — and its disclaimer sentence, which is built from these same 4 values so it can't drift out of sync with the real formula. Formula: employees_midpoint × hours-saved × hourly-rate × weeks-per-year, plus (sites_midpoint × loss-reduction-per-site) only when "theft/shrinkage" was picked in Question 7.

description: Superseded 2026-07-24 (see NOTES.md, "Solution Builder popup replaces Find Your Fit" entry): the old 3-question flow (Step 1/2/3 tabs) and its case-study/solution routing repeaters have been removed entirely, not left dormant. This options page controls the popup's modal shell copy (eyebrow/heading/subheading/trigger label), the 7 question prompts (shared by both footer.php's popup and page-solution-builder.php's standalone page), and the ROI estimate's 4 formula multipliers (2026-08-06, wp-admin content audit) — the popup shell itself, open/close mechanics, and progress-dot styling are unchanged. The *option lists* under each question (which industries, which employee-count bands, etc.) still come from inc/solution-builder.php's option-list functions, not from ACF — those are structural (each one has scoring weights and ROI midpoints tied to it in code), not copy.
